## Where we come from

<p class="sub">A genealogy of the ideas behind STITCH. The blue tags mark where each of us starts from; click a name to jump to their profile.</p>

{{< include _genealogy.qmd >}}

```{=html}
<script>
// Link genealogy tags and member cards both ways
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  const chips = [...document.querySelectorAll(".g-chip")];
  const cards = [...document.querySelectorAll(".member[data-member]")];
  const set = (id, on) => {
    chips.filter(c => c.dataset.member === id).forEach(c => c.classList.toggle("is-on", on));
    cards.filter(c => c.dataset.member === id).forEach(c => c.classList.toggle("is-on", on));
  };
  [...chips, ...cards].forEach(el => {
    el.addEventListener("mouseenter", () => set(el.dataset.member, true));
    el.addEventListener("mouseleave", () => set(el.dataset.member, false));
  });
  chips.forEach(c => c.addEventListener("click", e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const card = document.getElementById("m-" + c.dataset.member);
    if (!card) return;
    card.scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth", block: "center" });
    card.classList.remove("flash"); void card.offsetWidth; card.classList.add("flash");
  }));
});
</script>
```
